passage.title: Market stall booking
passage.text:
Market stall booking

Traders may book a stall for Saturday or Sunday. The fee is 12 pounds for a single day and 20 pounds for the weekend. Booking closes on Thursday at noon. A trader who cancels after Thursday will not receive a refund. Tables are not provided; traders must bring their own.

questions.stem: In the booking notice, the word "refund" most nearly means:

options.label: B
options.text: a table provided by the market

options.label: C
options.text: a fee charged for a weekend stall

options.label: D
options.text: a change to the booking day

questions.evidence: A trader who cancels after Thursday will not receive a refund.
questions.reasoning: The sentence says a trader who cancels after Thursday will not receive money back, so a refund is money returned after a cancellation.

option_reasoning.A: The sentence contrasts cancelling with receiving money back, which is a refund.
option_reasoning.B: The notice says tables are not provided; it does not define refund.
option_reasoning.C: The fee is charged for a stall, not returned after a cancellation.
option_reasoning.D: A booking day can change, but the sentence is about money after cancellation.
